ingredients: 1/2–1 1/2 tbsp Sichuan peppercorns, finely ground (reserve 1/4 tsp for garnish; use less for milder)
1 lb silken tofu, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes

items: 1/2–1 1/2 tbsp Sichuan peppercorns, finely ground (reserve 1/4 tsp for garnish; use less for milder)

groups.title: Main
items: 1 lb silken tofu, cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes

steps: Toast the chiles (skip if using prepared chili oil): heat half the oil over low heat. Add fresh + dried chiles and toast ~5 minutes until fragrant (don’t burn). Remove from heat and set aside.
Cook aromatics: heat remaining oil over medium. Add ginger (1 minute), then garlic (1 minute).
Cook pork + peppercorn: turn heat to high and add ground pork. Break up and fry until cooked through. Add ground Sichuan peppercorn and stir 15–30 seconds (avoid burning).
Season + simmer: stir in spicy bean sauce. Add chicken broth and simmer ~1 minute.
Thicken: mix cornstarch + water, add slurry to the wok, and simmer until thickened (thin with a splash of water/stock if needed).
Add chili oil + tofu: add the toasted chili oil (and chiles). Gently toss tofu into the sauce and cook 3–5 minutes.
Finish: add sesame oil + sugar (if using) and scallion; stir just until scallion wilts. Garnish with reserved Sichuan peppercorn powder if desired.
